## Message

```
[X18N0003] Unknown project <detail>
├▶ fix: Pick a project name listed by `x18n status`, for example with `--project`.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n0003
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

The command needs one project, but the name you gave matches none, or the workspace has several projects and you gave no name.

1. Run `x18n status` to list the project names.
2. Pass one of them with `--project <name>`.

Commands that write files (`set`, `apply`, `rename`, `delete`, `fill`, `format`, `extract`, `prompt`) always need one project in a monorepo.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `2`.
